graphs.title: The ratio falls as the cube gets bigger.
graphs.label: Surface area to volume ratio

experiment.aim: To find how the surface area to volume ratio changes with the size of a cube
experiment.hypothesis: The bigger the cube, the smaller the surface area to volume ratio
experiment.dependent: Surface area to volume ratio (per cm)

steps: Set the side to 1 cm and press Record.
Set the side to 2 cm and press Record.
Set the side to 3 cm and press Record.
title: Why are cells small? Agar cubes
goal: See how the surface area to volume ratio changes as a cube gets bigger.
note: Substances enter a cell through its surface, but they are used by its whole volume. A cube with a bigger side has a smaller surface area to volume ratio.
